name: Toudou Shion
source: Someone who's close to the king of the white wing clan. At the moment, he's looking after Kurisu, while working as a history teacher at Yuusei Academy. He's also the advisor of the literature and the karate club. A sincere and loyal person, who has a strong sense of justice.
